breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly includes the torsional shear stress at the outer surface (τ ≈ 59 MPa) and uses it in the plane stress analysis in part (c) with τ_xy = 59 MPa. It does NOT repeat the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt that the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. This matches the ground truth, which also omits that erroneous statement and treats both bending normal stress and torsional shear stress as present at the outer surface.
